evidence.detail: Iter-2 path re-run: item with Targets '-' and Requirements '-' given as ROADMAP_ITEM. 60.workflow-release.srs.md:15707 (FR-FLOW-226 AC-1) now has the single run-start `update_roadmap_item` add the run's product target to `Targets` when the item does not list it, with a reason naming `run_id` (FR-NODE-256 AC-4 requires a reason for a Targets change: supplied). An unregistered target is only warning ROADMAP-W009 (20.parser-validation.srs.md:3064), so FR-NODE-256 AC-6 does not refuse the write before kiwi-srs registers the target. At run end T = {product target} and R = its requirements (FR-NODE-255 AC-1, 50.nodejs-implementation.srs.md:17122); with all verified, AC-2 (:17123) gives `done`, and FR-NODE-257 AC-1 (:17271) proposes Actual End. The idea-at-run-end outcome no longer occurs.

findings.description: The unlinked-item path now records Actual End: the run links its product target to the item at run start.

evidence.detail: Input: roadmap item RM-2 with `Targets` '-' and `Requirements` 'FR-A, FR-B', both requirements of existing target P, which holds ten other requirements that RM-2 does not list. The user runs `/kiwi-wave-master PRD_PATH=<prd> ROADMAP_ITEM=RM-2` with product target P and, by FR-FLOW-212 AC-4 (60.workflow-release.srs.md:14798), narrows the run to scope.requirements = {FR-A, FR-B} with recorded consent. (1) FR-FLOW-226 AC-1 (:15707): RM-2 does not list P in `Targets`, so the run-start update adds P. (2) FR-NODE-255 AC-1 (50.nodejs-implementation.srs.md:17122): R of RM-2 becomes all twelve requirements of P instead of {FR-A, FR-B}. (3) Run end: FR-A and FR-B verified, the ten others planned; FR-NODE-255 AC-2 (:17123) yields not `done` (R not all verified, P not completed) but `in-progress` (Actual Start set). (4) FR-NODE-257 AC-1 (:17271) proposes no `Actual End`, so the run-end `sync_roadmap_actuals` writes nothing. Under the iter-2 text the same input gave R = {FR-A, FR-B}, status `done`, and Actual End recorded. The item's progress (FR-NODE-255 AC-4, :17125) also jumps from the ACs of 2 requirements to those of 12. The Research note at 60.workflow-release.srs.md:15730 (unfinished requirements leave Actual End empty) does not cover this: the item's own requirements are finished; the unfinished ones entered the item only through AC-1.

findings.description: The F-2 fix adds the product target to every item that does not list it, including an item scoped by `Requirements`; that widens the item's requirement set to the whole target, so an item whose own requirements are all verified at run end stays in-progress and its Actual End is not recorded.
findings.suggested_action: Add the product target in the run-start update only when the item's R and T are both empty (computed status `idea`), or only when the item lists no `Requirements`; state the condition in AC-1.

evidence.detail: 60.workflow-release.srs.md:15677 (title): "records the actual start and end of its roadmap item at run start and run end, and changes nothing else in the roadmap"; :15694 (Requirement): "SHALL record that item's actual start when the run starts ... and SHALL otherwise only read the item." Against :15707 (AC-1): the run-start call "adds the run's product target to `Targets` WHEN the item does not list it". The Rationale ties AC-1 only to PRD-27's actual dates (:15700, "실제 날짜는 wave-master 가 기록한다"), and its `fills:` line (:15703) says "the run only records what happened"; no `fills:` line gives a basis for the `Targets` change. A test written from the statement (the item's rows other than Actual Start/End are unchanged after a run) fails on the AC-1 behaviour for any item that does not list the product target.

findings.description: The title and requirement statement say the run changes only the actual dates, while AC-1 now also writes `Targets`, and that clause carries no `fills:` basis.
findings.suggested_action: Rewrite the title and statement to include the target link (under the condition chosen for F-3), and add `fills: PRD-27 / hole / <reason>` for the `Targets` clause of AC-1.
